name: Faceless Gods
description: This is an idea that’s been with me for a long time. This Pantheon (LoRA) blends both Concept and Style . The Concept is ' Faceless Gods '. Otherworldly deities, both terrifying and divine, born from the depths of our collective unconscious , dreams , and nightmares . The Style merges dark fantasy with baroque and surrealism . Heavily inspired by the work of Peter Mohrbacher , H.R. Giger , Igor Kieryluk and Wayne Barlowe .
